# JianZiPu Font

> JianZiPu (减字谱) is a font for guqin tablature: you type a short code such as `s7k5` (or 名七勾五) and the font swaps each piece for a drawn part and stacks them into one 减字 character. The JZP Font Builder is the web app where the font is made: the drawn parts (glyphs), how each part is typed (spellings), and how the parts sit together (layouts).

The Builder (https://builder.jianzipufont.com) runs in the browser and asks testers to sign in, so its pages can't be read without one. Its help is published here instead.

## Docs

- [Builder help, full text](https://jianzipufont.com/help.md): every screen, how words are typed, saving, drafts, keyboard shortcuts, and what each message means and how to fix it
- [Builder help, with screenshots](https://jianzipufont.com/help/)
- [The JianZiPu font](https://jianzipufont.com/): download, and the typing guide (layout, numbers and decimals, modifiers, chords, vertical text, glossary)
